Name: Cat Lady Lucy - Redrawn in Nyapu's Style
Author: PureJJoy
Description:
Hi! I refreshed the Nyapu portraits for the Cat Lady Lucy mod for my own game, so I thought I share them with ya’ll ☺️

How to install:
[list=1]
[*]unzip the file[/*]
[*]copy the images in the folder[/*]
[*]paste them in “Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Custom NPC Lucia\assets”[/*]
[*]press replace files, and you’re done![/*]
[/list][i][b]
[color=#9900ff]This mod replaces the Nyapu style portraits made by Yuninocorn, so please make sure to select Nyapu Portraits in the config!!![/color][/b][/i]
